versions.subject: Created Win Regedit export rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\regedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /E '
selection_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'hklm'
        - 'hkey_local_machine'
selection_3:
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - '\system'
        - '\sam'
        - '\security'
condition: selection and selection_2 and selection_3
versions.spl: Image="*\\regedit.exe" CommandLine="* /E *" CommandLine IN ("*hklm*", "*hkey_local_machine*") CommandLine IN ("*\\system", "*\\sam", "*\\security")
